name: Marseille

cards.name: Le Mat
cards.essence: Le Mat is the unnumbered traveller, carrying possibility rather than proof.
cards.past: You came from a road without a fixed destination. The lack of a plan kept you moving.
cards.present: Leave room for the next encounter. The road is the teacher, and the first step is enough.
cards.future: A new road opens through movement. Do not ask it to promise the whole journey.
cards.question: What road would you take if arrival were not the point?

cards.name: Le Bateleur
cards.essence: Le Bateleur puts the tools of a life on the table.
cards.past: You learned by trying with what was at hand. That practical intelligence still serves you.
cards.present: Choose one tool and use it. The beginning becomes real through a simple gesture.
cards.future: A small opportunity asks for dexterity. Start before the arrangement feels perfect.
cards.question: What is already in your hands?

cards.name: La Papesse
cards.essence: La Papesse keeps knowledge until it has ripened enough to be shared.
cards.past: Something was learned quietly, through watching rather than announcing.
cards.present: Read the room and the page twice. The useful answer is behind the first impression.
cards.future: A hidden fact or patient study becomes important. Let time do part of the work.
cards.question: What needs more time before it is spoken?

cards.name: L'Imperatrice
cards.essence: L'Imperatrice makes an idea fertile, articulate and alive.
cards.past: A creative or relational force gave shape to the past. Notice what it taught you to value.
cards.present: Speak, draw or build the thing that wants form. Growth needs expression.
cards.future: A productive season approaches. Let your intelligence make the conditions richer.
cards.question: What wants to be brought into the world?

cards.name: L'Empereur
cards.essence: L'Empereur makes a stable place from which action can begin.
cards.past: A firm structure supported you, or constrained you. Both facts belong in the account.
cards.present: Set the practical terms. A clear limit protects the work from confusion.
cards.future: Responsibility arrives with a material shape: a decision, budget, room or role.
cards.question: What foundation would make you steadier?

cards.name: Le Pape
cards.essence: Le Pape connects a personal question to a shared wisdom.
cards.past: A teacher, elder or custom gave the past its language.
cards.present: Ask for counsel, but keep your judgment. Tradition is useful when it serves life.
cards.future: A helpful guide or agreement appears. Listen for what can be practiced, not merely admired.
cards.question: Whose experience could shorten your way?

cards.name: L'Amoureux
cards.essence: L'Amoureux is the pause where a choice becomes visible.
cards.past: An earlier attachment shaped the road. Its sweetness and its cost are both real.
cards.present: Do not let indecision disguise itself as kindness. Choose what you can stand behind.
cards.future: A meeting or crossroads asks for a clear preference. The heart needs a direction.
cards.question: What choice are you postponing by keeping every door open?

cards.name: Le Chariot
cards.essence: Le Chariot carries its opposing horses forward through direction.
cards.past: You advanced by holding competing needs in one frame.
cards.present: Keep the reins steady and the destination plain. Do not confuse haste with progress.
cards.future: A journey, move or decisive push gains momentum. Choose the route before the speed.
cards.question: What direction deserves your full effort?

cards.name: La Force
cards.essence: La Force joins a human hand to the animal life within it.
cards.past: You handled a difficult force through patience rather than display.
cards.present: Work with the living energy in the situation. Gentleness can be a form of command.
cards.future: A test of courage approaches. Stay close to the body and let steadiness lead.
cards.question: What strong feeling can you meet without fighting?

cards.name: L'Hermite
cards.essence: L'Hermite carries a small light and asks the next step to be enough.
cards.past: Solitude or experience taught you what noise could not.
cards.present: Reduce the pace. The right question will be easier to see when fewer things compete for it.
cards.future: A guide, retreat or patient craft brings the answer closer.
cards.question: What can only be learned slowly?

cards.name: La Roue de Fortune
cards.essence: La Roue de Fortune shows the situation changing under every fixed assumption.
cards.past: Chance and circumstance turned the past in a direction you did not choose alone.
cards.present: Watch for the opening in the turn. Prepare, but do not pretend to control the wheel.
cards.future: A change of circumstances arrives. Adaptation will be more useful than blame.
cards.question: What cycle is changing beneath your feet?

cards.name: La Justice
cards.essence: La Justice weighs the act and its result without decoration.
cards.past: A past decision still defines the terms. Meet its consequence without exaggerating it.
cards.present: Put the facts in order. Fairness begins with seeing the whole exchange.
cards.future: A ruling, agreement or correction makes the next step clearer.
cards.question: What would be fair if you included every person affected?

cards.name: Le Pendu
cards.essence: Le Pendu makes a pause into a different way of seeing.
cards.past: A delay or sacrifice changed your perspective more than action could have.
cards.present: Stop forcing the old route. Let the position reveal what it is asking of you.
cards.future: Progress arrives through a reversal, a pause or a willing concession.
cards.question: What could the pause give you that motion cannot?

cards.name: Arcane sans nom
cards.essence: Arcane sans nom clears what has finished so the image can change.
cards.past: The past contains a clean ending, even if the feelings around it are not clean yet.
cards.present: Prune without cruelty. The empty space is part of the new arrangement.
cards.future: A decisive change removes an old burden and makes a different life practical.
cards.question: What is finished even if you still miss it?

cards.name: Temperance
cards.essence: Temperance keeps two vessels moving until the mixture becomes usable.
cards.past: A compromise or healing practice taught you that balance is made, not found.
cards.present: Adjust the proportions. Small exchanges can restore a workable middle.
cards.future: Help, reconciliation or a useful blend becomes possible.
cards.question: What needs to be combined rather than chosen between?

cards.name: Le Diable
cards.essence: Le Diable shows the tie between appetite and the object that feeds it.
cards.past: A past bargain or habit still has a material grip. See the terms clearly.
cards.present: Name the attachment without shame, then decide whether its price is still acceptable.
cards.future: A strong temptation or practical dependency becomes visible. Knowledge restores choice.
cards.question: What are you maintaining because it is profitable, familiar or desired?

cards.name: La Maison-Dieu
cards.essence: La Maison-Dieu breaks an enclosure and lets the trapped life out.
cards.past: A disruption exposed the weakness in the old house. It also opened a door.
cards.present: Do not decorate the broken wall. Clear the site and keep what can be reused.
cards.future: A sudden event changes the practical arrangement. The truth will save time.
cards.question: What would you stop protecting if the wall fell?

cards.name: L'Etoile
cards.essence: L'Etoile pours trust into the world without trying to own it.
cards.past: Hope or a helpful example gave the past a direction after difficulty.
cards.present: Offer what you have freely and keep the channel open. Renewal needs circulation.
cards.future: A quiet sign, ally or clear hope appears. Follow the direction that restores you.
cards.question: What small light is already enough to follow?

cards.name: La Lune
cards.essence: La Lune makes the road uncertain but does not make it unreal.
cards.past: Fear or imagination colored an earlier chapter. The picture deserves a second look.
cards.present: Move carefully through incomplete information. Let observation outrank assumption.
cards.future: A dream, doubt or hidden motive becomes visible. Wait for more light before deciding.
cards.question: What part of the picture still needs daylight?

cards.name: Le Soleil
cards.essence: Le Soleil puts two lives under one clear source of warmth.
cards.past: A period of openness showed you what mutual joy feels like in practice.
cards.present: Let the facts be bright. Share the good news without making it complicated.
cards.future: Recognition, health or a plain success warms the next stage.
cards.question: What is clear enough to celebrate?

cards.name: Le Jugement
cards.essence: Le Jugement calls what was buried back into relationship with the living.
cards.past: A past decision or awakening still asks to be acknowledged.
cards.present: Answer the call by making a concrete change, not by repeating the feeling of it.
cards.future: A return, announcement or second chance asks you to stand up and participate.
cards.question: What is asking to be brought back into your life?

cards.name: Le Monde
cards.essence: Le Monde gathers the four directions into one finished passage.
cards.past: A cycle completed and gave you a wider sense of where you belong.
cards.present: Finish what remains and let the result be visible. Completion is a shared fact.
cards.future: A successful passage opens the next world. Carry the skill, not the old limit.
cards.question: What would you recognize as complete?

pairs: Le Mat and Le Monde make a complete road: departure and arrival belong to one passage.
Le Bateleur and La Papesse put the visible tool beside the hidden book. Act, then read what the act reveals.
L'Imperatrice and L'Empereur join growth to ground. Give the living project a place and a limit.
L'Empereur and Le Pape ask whether order comes from your own rule or from a shared custom.
Le Pape and L'Hermite offer counsel in two forms: what is handed down and what is learned alone.
L'Amoureux becoming Le Chariot: a choice leaves the crossroads and becomes a direction.
Le Chariot and La Force turn movement into composure. The strongest hand is the one that keeps the reins steady.
La Force beside Le Diable shows the difference between holding desire and being held by it.
La Roue de Fortune turning into La Maison-Dieu is change that reveals the structure beneath the change.
La Justice into Le Pendu: after measuring the situation, allow the pause to change your judgment.
Le Pendu and Arcane sans nom turn suspension into release. What is not forced can finally finish.
Arcane sans nom opening into L'Etoile shows hope growing in the space made by pruning.
Temperance and Le Diable ask whether appetite can be given a measure without being denied.
La Maison-Dieu followed by L'Etoile: the broken enclosure becomes an opening for guidance.
L'Etoile and La Lune keep a small light alive while the path remains uncertain.
La Lune becoming Le Soleil is uncertainty becoming a fact you can stand in.
Le Soleil into Le Jugement turns clarity into a call to act on what has become obvious.
Le Jugement into Le Monde gives the call a place in the completed life.
La Papesse and La Lune speak in quiet images. Observe before you decide what the picture means.
L'Amoureux and Le Diable make attachment visible. A bond becomes healthier when its price can be named.
L'Hermite and La Roue: a quiet interval changes how you recognize the next turn.
Temperance and Le Monde show wholeness as a repeated practical adjustment, not a final pose.

The numbered road rises from %1 to %2. Each card asks the next practical question of the journey.
The numbered road falls from %1 to %2. An earlier condition returns, now seen from the experience gained since then.
%1 in the present is the high point. Past and future show what this central action makes possible.
%1 in the present is the low point between two stronger pulls. The pause needs a choice or a change of hands.
plane:
All three cards belong to %1: %2. Read the details of ordinary life closely; they contain the answer.
The reading moves from %1 into %2. What begins as %3 ends as %4.
The reading comes down from %1 to %2. An idea is asking for a practical form.
Past and future share %1; only the present enters %2. The interruption shows where the work is.
dominant:
Fire is strongest here. Act with courage, but give the action a clear object.
Water is strongest here. Attend to feeling, memory and the movement beneath the words.
Air is strongest here. Conversation, choice and proportion will change the situation.
Earth is strongest here. Look at the body, the money, the room and the work itself.
No element leads. The answer is in how the four conditions meet in ordinary life.
transition:
%1 and %2 share %3, so the movement between them is direct. Follow the repeated detail.
%1 (%2) and %3 (%4) pull against each other: action meets feeling. Name the choice between them.
%1 (%2) and %3 (%4) pull against each other: thought meets circumstance. Find the action that joins them.
%1 (%2) feeds %3 (%4). This passage has support; use it before the conditions change.
hidden: The three values total %1. Their reduced card is %2, the quiet condition beneath the spread: %3
hiddenRepeated: It is already present in the %1 position, so the same lesson is asking to be lived twice.
